areas.t: On Wednesday November 4th, expect moderate air quality in southern Vermont and mountain valley locations, as the region continues to be subject to overnight thermal inversions, and slightly elevated levels of PM25 to our south in the Philadelphia area on Tuesday makes its way into southern Vermont.
